TeamSlot.title: TeamSlot
TeamSlot.description: Publicly visible registered team entry for one of the 24 RCL 2027 tournament slots.

teamNameKey.description: Normalized unique key for the team name.

brandName.description: Required team title or tagline without length/uniqueness restrictions.

brandNameKey.description: Legacy normalized key for the team title/brand name.

logoUrl.description: Download URL or compact compressed image Data URL for the team logo.

captainPhone.description: Captain's 10-digit contact mobile number displayed on the team card.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest team details update.

paymentStatus.description: Fee payment status for the registered team (defaults to pending).

paymentScreenshotUrl.description: Download URL or compact compressed image Data URL for the team payment screenshot.

UniqueKeyReservation.title: UniqueKeyReservation
UniqueKeyReservation.description: Uniqueness index document mapping a normalized team or brand key to its slot ID.

TeamRegistrationPrivate.title: TeamRegistrationPrivate
TeamRegistrationPrivate.description: Private captain contact and ownership record for a registered team slot.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registering user.

RegistrationSequence.title: RegistrationSequence
RegistrationSequence.description: Sequential slot counter ensuring slots 1..24 are assigned strictly in order.

nextSlot.description: Next available slot number (2..25 after registration).

/teams/{teamId}.description: Publicly readable list of registered RCL 2027 teams (slot-1 through slot-24) without private phone numbers.

/teamNames/{nameKey}.description: Uniqueness reservation documents for team names.

/teamBrands/{brandKey}.description: Uniqueness reservation documents for team brand names.

/teamRegistrations/{teamId}.description: Private registration records containing captainPhone and ownerUid, readable only by the owner or admin.

/registrationMeta/{metaId}.description: Registration sequence metadata document at registrationMeta/sequence.
